title: E-Marinade
text: app provides two workspaces: European Introduction Map — regional view: NIS occur species present. Species Explorer — species view: introduced vs native ranges selected taxa. data tables support search, filter (available), scroll, export (Clipboard / CSV / Excel).

title: E-Marinade
text: aim European Introduction Map inspect NIS richness MEOW ecoregion list species present selected region.  map composed polygons correspond MEOW ecoregions (see Spalding et al. 2007 description regions). polygon filled color represents number unique NIS recorded ecoregion. hover region, tooltip appears showing ecoregion name corresponding NIS count. can navigate map zooming panning mouse, trackpad, -screen controls. inspect specific region, simply click polygon. label “Selected Ecoregion(s)” update, species table located map refresh automatically display species present chosen region. also possible select multiple regions, case table aggregate species across selected areas. clear selections return default view, use Reset Table button. species table displayed map contains several columns: taxonomy (Kindgom Species), AphiaID identifier linking species World Register Marine Species database, year first observation taxon area, MSFD subregion, associated Realm, Province, Ecoregion Marine Ecoregion World framework. table also specifies original source record.

title: E-Marinade
text: purpose Species Explorer inspect introduced native ranges selected species. Users can provide input either selecting directly taxonomic table entering species names AphiaIDs text box. Table mode, process straightforward: locate taxonomic table, click row select species, use species drop-menu adjust selection, allowing multiple species explored .  Text mode, input given manually. switch input text, choose taxonomic level (default Species, AphiaIDs disabled broader levels Genus Family), paste one entry per line, either species name AphiaID (available taxonomic level choosen “Species”). example: Caulerpa taxifolia 417798 Homo sapiens  app displays warning box names IDs invalid. corrected, species drop-menu can used finalize set species examined. species selected, app displays single interactive map overlays introduced/cryptogenic native ranges time. legend clearly distinguishes categories users can interpret results easily. multiple species selected, overlapping regions styled distinctly, region contains introduced cryptogenic records, shown different color clarity. Note Native multiple sp. Introduced multiple sp. map legend indicate ecoregions native area two selected NIS, introduced region two NIS.  maps, two range tables provided. Introduced Range table lists regions selected species introduced cryptogenic, Native Range table lists native regions. tables include powerful functions global search, optional column filters, data export Copy (clipboard), CSV, Excel formats, scroll bars handle wide long datasets. Note data available given category (example, native polygons known species), corresponding panel remains empty.

title: E-Marinade
text: following examples illustrate main ways interact application. use case outlines sequence actions corresponding outputs. regional scan, start opening European Introduction Map. Hover regions check NIS counts, click one regions select . species table map update automatically show species recorded selected areas. reviewed, table can exported CSV Excel format analysis. species comparison, go Species Explorer table mode. Select one multiple species taxonomic table. Use map see maps, consult introduced native range tables, export needed. batch list query, change input mode text. Paste list species names/taxonomic level interest AphiaIDs, one per line, text box. invalid entries flagged warning box; correct re-run search necessary. Species drop-menu allows refine list valid species plot show table, can explore maps range tables export results.

title: E-Marinade
text: Empty results: panel shows data, usually means species records specific category. example, species may lack native polygons database. cases, check panel (Introduced Native) see information available . Invalid text input: Errors can occur species names misspelled AphiaIDs entered incorrectly. Always use correct spelling verify AphiaIDs reliable sources WoRMS. invalid entries detected, app displays warning box listing problematic items can correct re-run search. Performance: Large queries many species may slow map rendering table updates. improve responsiveness, start smaller set species gradually increase number needed. Reset: interface becomes cluttered selections confusing, can reset easily. Species Explorer, use Deselect button drop-menu reset taxonomic table outputs. European Introduction Map, use Reset Table button clear selected regions.
